topic: Punctuation spacing after inline HTML tags: what Firecrawl and the kit's keyless HTML-to-Markdown converter write before . , ; : ! ? % ) ] } and after ( [ {, and how Firecrawl documents its HTML-to-Markdown conversion
notes: Phase 0 was a dry run; pages named directly. Run 1: every URL keyless (free); three converter source files were added after the first keyless run read html-to-markdown.ts, and collected keyless in a second free run. Run 2: the two test pages through firecrawl-cli with --force (research/plan-firecrawl.json, 2 credits). Run 3: the first test page keyless again with --force (research/plan-keyless-refetch.json), so that each transport has one current capture an unknown can cite (ADR-0026 supersession).
